listing.name: Need for Speed: Carbon (Xbox 360) — NFS CARBON 360 DECOMP (codepdbh)
listing.summary: This is experimental. The project reports Android menus, scenery and video near 60 FPS on an S25. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own Need for Speed: Carbon (Xbox 360) Xbox 360 complete extracted game files, including the original executable. Title 454107EC/media 5E74E60D; this guide does not include the XEX SHA-256. Check the project’s exact original-file requirements before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Generate the Carbon game code and shader library locally from your own disc, then package the Android or Windows target using the project’s instructions.

warnings: This is experimental. The project reports Android menus, scenery and video near 60 FPS on an S25.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
